tier_should.rationale: Comprehensive meta-analysis links lead exposure to learning deficits; rigorous corrections for bias, policy simulations. Solid methodology and original extension beyond IQ, but all observational data limits causal certainty, nudging below top-field threshold.

tier_will.rationale: Likely placed in strong development or environmental-health field journal (e.g., JDE, JEEM, Env Health); causal concerns and policy extrapolations may block entry to elite general outlets despite CGD authorship and topical relevance.
